nodes.label: Curated Diary over Event Log
nodes.rationale: A completion later reopened or undone does not appear as done: the diary cannot state something no longer true.

nodes.label: Reminders (only while app open)
nodes.rationale: Accepted limit: PWA has no scheduled local notifications; no backend or Capacitor added.

nodes.label: Tabs Navigation (vistaAhora, vistaHoy, vistaTablero, vistaCompras, vistaMisiones, vistaRegistro)
nodes.norm_label: tabs navigation (vistaahora, vistahoy, vistatablero, vistacompras, vistamisiones, vistaregistro)

nodes.label: Data Flow (load, normalize, generate, derive, paint, mutate)
nodes.norm_label: data flow (load, normalize, generate, derive, paint, mutate)

nodes.label: Gaps vs Personal Control Center Vision
nodes.norm_label: gaps vs personal control center vision

nodes.label: AHORA Next Move Scoring
nodes.rationale: KCO always opens in AHORA: the question on open is what to do now; each score rule yields an explainable reason.

nodes.label: Anti-Farming Rules
nodes.rationale: Urgent pays same as Important (labeling is not progress); quick-log 2 XP; 200 XP daily cap; 3 milestones/day; 10-minute milestone age; one full mission/day.

nodes.label: Self-Learning Catalogs (solicitantes, destinos)
nodes.rationale: Personal names never in code: repo is public, catalogs live only on the phone.

nodes.label: Android Back Layering, Gestures and Animations
nodes.norm_label: android back layering, gestures and animations

nodes.label: Four-Level Priority (nivel + legacy prioridad)
nodes.rationale: Legacy boolean prioridad still written (true only for Urgente) so older KCO versions see urgent items as high priority.

nodes.label: Routines (definitions + occurrences)
nodes.rationale: Only the latest due occurrence is generated so opening after days does not pile up backlog; stale open ones close as vencida.

nodes.label: Derived Situations (five visible states)
nodes.rationale: Situation is never stored; derived at paint time to answer what matters when opening the app.

nodes.label: Feature: KCO Personal Control Center v2.0.0
nodes.norm_label: feature: kco personal control center v2.0.0

nodes.label: Asymmetric Contexts (factory flow only in Trabajo)
nodes.norm_label: asymmetric contexts (factory flow only in trabajo)
nodes.rationale: Central decision since v0.7: Trabajo carries purchase OC/OT/+48h complexity; other contexts use a simple list to avoid leaking factory flow.

nodes.label: Data Schema 4 (unchanged)
nodes.rationale: 2.0 only adds fields with fallback and new keys; bumping to 5 would make older KCO reject 2.0 backups and leave rollback read-only.

nodes.label: Derived XP
nodes.rationale: XP is recomputed from data, never stored: reopen subtracts, recomplete does not double, restored backup gives identical XP.

nodes.label: Route Declaration (inline then delegated + native RDD)
nodes.norm_label: route declaration (inline then delegated + native rdd)
nodes.rationale: Originally inline because one tightly-coupled 2.9k-line file; from T12a the user requested full orchestrator with delegated writer and native RDD.

nodes.label: Zero-Dependency E2E Harness (headless Edge/Chrome over CDP)
nodes.norm_label: zero-dependency e2e harness (headless edge/chrome over cdp)

nodes.label: Release Checklist (VERSION, CACHE bump)
nodes.rationale: Even a one-line change needs a cache name bump or the phone keeps serving the old file.

nodes.label: T12 Backup/Restore, PWA Offline, Security Review
nodes.norm_label: t12 backup/restore, pwa offline, security review

nodes.label: Strict CSP (script-src 'self')
nodes.rationale: No inline JS or external origins: injected text cannot execute code.

nodes.label: Pure Core Separation (window.KCOCore UMD)
nodes.rationale: Rules testable in Node without a browser, with 'today' passed as a parameter.

nodes.label: No Libraries, No Build
nodes.rationale: Published file is tested file; zero dependencies; works on old Android WebViews.

nodes.label: Audit Decisions (incremental evolution, extract core, E2E first)
nodes.norm_label: audit decisions (incremental evolution, extract core, e2e first)
